BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: III
BRANCH: ALL  SESSION : MO/2018

SUBJECT : CS3101- JAVA PROGRAMMING & WEB TECHNOLOGY

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Q1 (a) What is the output of the following code:-

public class BitMesra {
    public static void main(String[ ] args)
    {
        String collegeName = "Bit Mesra ranks 26th in NIRF";

        System.out.println(collegeName.charAt(4));
        System.out.println(collegeName.substring(10));
        System.out.println(collegeName.indexOf( 't' ,2));
        System.out.println(collegeName.trim());
          }
    }
[2]
 (b) What is method overloading? Explain with an example. [3]


Q2 (a) What is the difference between private and protected access modifiers? [2]
 (b) What is instance of operator in java? Explain with suitable example. [3]


Q3 (a) What happens if a class is declared as final? [2]
 (b) Write any six rules of interface. [3]


Q4 (a) What is the difference between creating String as new() and literal? [2]
 (b) Write a simple java code to show ‘passing objects to methods’. [3]


Q5 (a) Write any four predefined classes which are inside java.lang package. [2]
 (b) Explain all the primitive datatypes in java with their default values.  [3]


Q6 (a) What is the correct datatype for account number (15 digits) and IFSC code in bank? [2]
 (b) Write a java code to show multiple inheritance using interface. [3]
